title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper TurboFNO: High-Performance Fourier Neural Operator with Fused FFT-GEMM-iFFT on GPU
problem: Reproducibility report meta-paper: evaluation of artifact reproducibility for TurboFNO paper (full paper analysis not available from abstract)
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative requires detailed artifact evaluation to ensure published research can be reproduced and results verified.
method: Artifact evaluation conducted by SC25 Reproducibility Committee member, assessing the Artifact Description and Evaluation appendix of the TurboFNO paper.
key_novelty: This is a reproducibility report, not a research contribution paper.
contributions: Evaluation and verification of TurboFNO artifact reproducibility
Documentation of reproducibility findings and methodology
limitations: Reproducibility report; no technical details available from abstract. Original TurboFNO paper needed for full analysis.
